How the consortium works

One engagement, both packages

Every SME that onboards this consortium gets both tracks

The Economic track (BCS) is a fixed quality-and-productivity programme. The Ecological track (Tekcellent) adds a sustainability or climate module tailored to the enterprise's needs. The result is a single DfS engagement that strengthens both operational performance and environmental/ESG readiness at the same time.

1

Economic track — delivered by BCS

Fixed programme · included for every SME

Quality Tools & Lean implementation

5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Line Balancing, Total Productive Maintenance, Six Sigma.

Management system certification consultancy

ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and FSSC 22000 certification support, plus Exemplar Global accredited Lead Auditor training.

Occupational Health & Safety

OHS practices embedded alongside quality and productivity improvement on the shop floor.

ILO SCORE & capacity building

Continuation of the ILO/ILES SCORE programme, change-management-team training, and partnership with NED University's academy for certification.

2

Ecological track — delivered by Tekcellent

Sustainability & climate modules
01

Sustainability & Climate Risks & Opportunities Assessment

Identifies and prioritises the enterprise's top climate and sustainability risks, then builds a risk-action roadmap with owners and timelines.

02

ESG KPIs & Target Setting

Benchmarks existing indicators, agrees 5–8 practical ESG KPIs, and delivers a simple tracker with 1–2 year targets.

03

ESG & Climate Disclosures (IFRS S1, S2 & GRI)

Gap-scans current disclosures against IFRS S1/S2 and GRI, then builds a disclosure checklist and reporting-responsibility map.

04

EHS Gap Analysis & Corrective Action Planning

Site walkthrough to flag critical/high-risk EHS gaps, with a prioritised corrective-action tracker for the worst issues.

05

Circular Economy Opportunities Assessment

Maps material, waste and input flows, then identifies 2–3 quick-win, low/no-CAPEX circular opportunities.

06

Resource Efficiency & Conservation Assessment

Walk-through of boilers, compressors, motors and water systems to flag inefficiencies, with 3–5 quick energy- and water-saving actions identified.

Each module follows the same DfS cycle: assess, dialogue workshop, co-create solutions, action plan, follow-up review.

Consortium leads

Meet the people leading each track

Saif ur Rahman
Co-Founder, BCS · Economic Track Lead

More than 35 years of experience as a management-system auditor, consultant and trainer. Certified in Quality Management System, Environmental Management System, Occupational Health & Safety Management System and Food Safety Management System auditing, with experience setting up new institutes and regional offices at PSQCA and NPO. He is a certified trainer/consultant for the ILO SCORE, FIT and Better Work programmes, and for GIZ's Dialogue for Sustainability programme.

Maryam Asim
Focal Person, Tekcellent · Ecological Track Lead

Leads Tekcellent's side of the engagement, drawing on the firm's 20 years of sustainability, ESG and engineering consultancy across pharmaceutical, power, FMCG, textiles and oil & gas sectors, and its institutional work with IFC, the World Bank and UNIDO.

Methodology

  • Cross-functional technical assessment & baseline review
  • On-site DfS dialogue workshops with key departments and workers
  • Co-creation of priority actions with the enterprise's own team
  • Risk/action matrices, KPI trackers and corrective-action plans
  • Follow-up review of progress against the baseline

Expected outcomes

  • Improved quality, productivity and lean practices on the floor
  • Progress toward management-system certification (ISO 9001/14001/45001/FSSC 22000)
  • A practical sustainability/climate roadmap in the SME's selected ecological module
  • Stronger ESG, EHS or energy readiness, depending on the module chosen
  • One combined set of reports and action plans covering both pillars
Track record

Demonstrated experience across quality, lean and sustainability consulting

BCS has completed 70+ management-system consultancy engagements — mainly ISO 9001/14001 certification work — across textile, garment, leather, food-processing and general manufacturing clients, plus ILO SCORE, FIT and Better Work assignments since 2019. Tekcellent brings 20 years of sustainability, ESG and engineering consultancy with institutional clients including IFC, the World Bank and UNIDO, and corporate clients across pharmaceuticals, FMCG, textiles, power and oil & gas.
